faqs.q: Is it worth doing SEO in such a small market?
faqs.a: Yes, precisely because it is small. Competition is thin, so good work ranks faster and cheaper than in large markets. Small pond, fewer fishermen, more fish per net.

faqs.q: Latvian or Russian content, which first?
faqs.a: Latvian first, always, since it is the majority language of search. Add Russian versions of your top pages second. Together they cover the overwhelming majority of local queries.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take in Latvia?
faqs.a: Local Latvian keywords often move in 2 to 3 months. The competition is thin enough that consistent fundamentals, profile, reviews, content, outperform most rivals quickly.

faqs.q: Can you help with Jurmala tourism seasonality?
faqs.a: Yes. Tourism keywords need pages built well ahead of summer, in the languages visitors search in. Winter is build season; summer is harvest season.

faqs.q: What does SEO cost for a Latvian business?
faqs.a: Less than in most of Europe, because the workload to outrank local competitors is smaller. After a free audit I quote a fixed monthly scope matched to your market.
